transcript: Alright, how to do Reiko's command grab combo with Tremor. First things first, you're going to want to switch from Aftershock to Crystalline, and I usually do that by pressing down and R1. Keep in mind I have default controls. Second step, obviously you want to go for the command grab, and then right before he's about to dunk his head, you want to press R1, which will switch you back to Aftershock. Don't forget guys, the key to all this working is the rolling backwards part when you go for the command grab. If you don't roll backwards, he'll go to the right side or vice versa. Rolling backwards is what you want to do by default always. And then once you do that, you're going to want to delay the ground pound from Aftershock Tremor, while simultaneously rolling backwards. From top to bottom, I usually throw a star or something to get myself into Crystalline. So boom, now I'm in the proper position. And then I go ahead and command grab, switch, delay, 3-4 slide, jump 2-1-4. Where are you going? Good job. Good job. Good job. Good job. Good job. Good job. Good job. Good job. Good job. Good job.
